one_liner: A pre-execution policy engine: every proposed write is evaluated against a versioned policy file — approved with a gate stamp, or denied with the named rule.
what_it_does: This lamp is a checkpoint that every proposed transaction must pass through before it goes out. A transfer to a non-allowlisted address was denied with the exact rule named; an allowed one passed with a gate stamp. Proven by 1 real on-chain transaction plus 4 evaluated runs including a live denial, all linked below.

config_plain.label: Decisions
config_plain.value: APPROVE with gate stamp, DENY with named rule
